task_name: Northwind Advisory - Team page and recruitment collateral
client_brief:
Make eight advisers look like one firm across the site and leave-behind

Northwind Advisory's team photographs were taken on three separate mornings. At present, we look like three different firms. We need a coherent portrait treatment and the team page, capabilities leave-behind and announcement posts built around it.

Please prepare
- Advisory team-page composition: 1 named export. 
- Capabilities leave-behind: 1 named export. The sector offer is clearly structured. No unsupported credential is added.
- Recruitment announcement: 1 named export. The approved role or recruitment offer is clear. The application action is readable.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Boutique institutional wealth advisory serving endowments, foundations and around forty families.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2009, Boston, Massachusetts, eight advisers on one floor on Federal Street.
brand_identity.about: Northwind Advisory Partners advises endowments, foundations and around forty families on the long term stewardship of institutional and family capital. We are eight people on one floor, and most mandates we win begin with a trustee reading our team page and deciding whether we look like a firm they can place a hundred million dollars with. The brand exists to signal exactly that: a fiduciary, uniform, unshowy, credentialled, judged by a committee rather than an audience.
brand_identity.audience: Endowment trustees, foundation investment committees and families with twenty million dollars and up. Readers aged 45 to 75, most of them reading printed pages and reviewing a credentials table before a mandate is placed.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Billed 350 to 600 dollars an hour. Boutique institutional tier: understated and fiduciary, deliberately not luxury editorial personal branding and not startup about us.
brand_identity.typography: One classical system: a restrained transitional serif for the firm name, headings and the credentials table, paired with a quiet sans for labels and contact lines. Wide margins, generous leading, a text size a trustee reads without effort. No display face, no oversized first names.
brand_identity.voice: Measured, plain, institutional. Speaks of stewardship and process, never of performance promises. Example line the firm would write: We advise a small number of institutions and families on capital they intend to hold for generations. No superlatives, no exclamation points.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The firm mark is a compass rose and wordmark. Two versions survive and neither is a working file: a flat raster export pulled off the old website, and a photograph of the letterpressed card the mark was originally cut for. The mark has to be recovered as placeable artwork with its counters intact before the rebuilt pages can carry it. A third rendering survives on a foil-blocked presentation folder that carries the compass rose alone at large scale, and the only standalone emblem the old web developer ever produced is a fuzzy favicon that blurs at any size, so the mark cannot ship as one lockup: it has to be rebuilt as a working family across formats, from letterhead down to the browser icon, with its counters holding at every reproduction size. Regulated credential designations must be reproduced exactly as the practice system holds them.
brand_identity.values: Fiduciary stewardship above all, and a uniform, sober face that reads as one firm rather than eight individuals.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve approved copy, dimensions, hierarchy, and reproduction requirements; do not imply a data merge or editable system that is outside the scoped deliverables.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export and the separately listed editable source.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.

assets.description: Transparent, tightly bounded Adobe-vectorized compass-and-wordmark master cleaned from the supplied artwork.
1600 px transparent raster companion for placement and preview.
White vector variant for approved dark-ground use.

human_cases.evidence_reference: One classical system: a restrained transitional serif for the firm name, headings and the credentials table, paired with a quiet sans for labels and contact lines. Wide margins, generous leading, a text size a trustee reads without effort. No display face, no oversized first names.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when text is present. A style-only brand guide requires expert judgement; no exact font name is invented.

human_cases.requirement: Logo treatment follows the identity permissions in the brief.
human_cases.pass_condition: Northwind Advisory Partners / Advisory team-page composition (team-page.png): Logo treatment follows the identity permissions in the brief.
human_cases.evidence_reference: The firm mark is a compass rose and wordmark. Two versions survive and neither is a working file: a flat raster export pulled off the old website, and a photograph of the letterpressed card the mark was originally cut for. The mark has to be recovered as placeable artwork with its counters intact before the rebuilt pages can carry it. A third rendering survives on a foil-blocked presentation folder that carries the compass rose alone at large scale, and the only standalone emblem the old web developer ever produced is a fuzzy favicon that blurs at any size, so the mark cannot ship as one lockup: it has to be rebuilt as a working family across formats, from letterhead down to the browser icon, with its counters holding at every reproduction size. Regulated credential designations must be reproduced exactly as the practice system holds them.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when a logo is required or used. Recovery briefs permit reconstruction; do not impose a false locked-logo rule.

A third rendering survives on a foil-blocked presentation folder that carries the compass rose alone at large scale, and the only standalone emblem the old web developer ever produced is a fuzzy favicon that blurs at any size, so the mark cannot ship as one lockup: it has to be rebuilt as a working family across formats, from letterhead down to the browser icon, with its counters holding at every reproduction size. Regulated credential designations must be reproduced exactly as the practice system holds them.
